explication: Tirreno is a self-hosted, in-application security framework: products send contextual events to its sensor/API, which enriches and records them for the operator console to analyze. The console supports dashboards and entity activity views, automated risk rules, manual review, and field-audit trails. The diagram shows the sampled event-ingestion calls and the application’s aggregator structure; major README capabilities with unsampled implementations are retained as subsystem nodes. Some links to those unsampled features are dashed and unverified.
